headline: Smith County Home Backup Report
summary: Homes in Smith County face a long outage about once every 3 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In recent events, 56% of homes lost power on June 2, 2024 with about 47 hours for the longest-waiting tenth. On January 30, 2023, 33% of homes lost power with about 58 hours for the longest-waiting tenth. One Core lasts about 17 hours in August and about 43 hours in February. Two Cores last about 34 hours in August. The suggested number of Cores is 2 Cores. Two Cores cover 91% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
